formulation: REDUCED: yaw solved from horizontal (u) evidence only; t_x=0 (camera directly above radar, measured), t_y=+74.9 mm (caliper: camera above radar), t_z=+8.8 mm (caliper, depth; sign assumed camera behind radar - effect <0.3%), pitch solved from known-height stations (stage B), roll=0 (mechanical). dv_note: v calibrated via pitch from stations at antenna height (radar z := 0). For targets NOT at antenna height the radar z is still unusable on this rig - projected v is only correct near antenna height / far range.
convention: p_C = R @ p_R + t; radar x fwd y left z up; camera x right y down z fwd
